description: start — or resume after a disconnect — a pull-mode execution session on a Work Breakdown Structure: mark it in progress, ensure its work-product register exists, and report which steps are already durably executed.
embedding_description: Begin or resume driving a work breakdown structure in pull mode. Marks the WBS in progress, initializes the work-product register, and reports already-executed steps plus the next step so an agent session can pick up execution from wherever the previous driver stopped. Idempotent: calling again after a bridge death is the resume path.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Session state with keys: wbs_id, status, resumed, executed_step_numbers, next
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: State whether this is a fresh start or a resume (resumed flag + executed_step_numbers), then present the next envelope's kind and step.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Execute the step described in next (kind='execute'), stop for the operator on kind='await_user', or close out on kind='complete'. Use get_next_wbs_step to re-fetch the envelope at any time.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Starting or resuming pull-mode execution of a Work Breakdown Structure. start_wbs_execution accepts {wbs_id}.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFound: no WBS tracking row or document exists for this wbs_id. ValidationError: the WBS status does not permit execution (e.g. superseded or already completed), or the arguments do not conform to the schema.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: NotFound: verify the wbs_id against the registered WBS documents. Status conflicts: a completed or superseded WBS is not executable — author or register a new WBS instead of re-running the old one.
